remarks: Rent includes heat, hot water & parking! This stunning & large apartment is a privately situated, top floor, corner apartment tucked away in the heart of downtown Stamford and offers sunny, bright, space with high 9' ceilings, hardwood floors throughout, character & charm! Enjoy 1200+ square feet, a cool Euro-inspired kitchen & windows galore. The Primary bedroom has a private newer bath w/shower stall. The second bedroom is also very large! Welcome to 70 Strawberry Hill, an enchanting mid-rise apartment community set back from the road on picturesque grounds enhanced with courtyards of flowers, gardens & trees!  On site super. Common area laundry & storage available on lower level. Pet friendly, 1-dog permitted, must be 20 lbs. and per owner & management discretion. Enjoy quality space steps to all downtown Stamford attractions & conveniences. Tenant just vacated, cleaning in progress. Will be immaculately presented to our new resident!
